body:
Thanks for reporting. There is a known limitation for attribute names, where characters other than `-` are not escaped properly. This is causing the dot `.` in the attribute name to end up as raw property name in the generated code, where it should be escaped.

**edit** for reference, tracked as FW-1136

issue.title: Ivy Renderer (beta)

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Label used to distinguish feature request from other issues

issue.body:
# Overview

Ivy is a new backwards-compatible Angular renderer focused on further speed improvements, size reduction, and increased flexibility.

Ivy is currently not feature complete, but can be tested via [`enableIvy: true`](https://next.angular.io/guide/aot-compiler#enableivy) [`angularCompilerOptions` flag](https://next.angular.io/guide/aot-compiler#angular-compiler-options).

We currently expect Ivy to remain behind the flag until it's feature complete and battle tested at Google. In the meantime you can check out this [Hello World demo](https://ng-ivy-demo.firebaseapp.com/).

To see status of Ivy implementation go [here](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/core/src/render3/STATUS.md).

Related Issues:
- [Tree-Shakeable Providers Followup Work](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/22830)

issue.body:
A temporary check is in place to determine whether a key in an object
literal needs to be quoted during emit. Previously, only the presence of
a dash caused a key to become quoted, this however is not sufficient for
@angular/flex-layout to compile properly as it has dots in its inputs.

This commit extends the check to also use quotes when a dot is present.

Fixes #30114
